assignment_rule: only saved Qualified and fully determined projections, complete determinate relation; state identities bind task/protocol/generation/rules and actual semantic graph
comparison_authority: exact semantic-label-preserving graph isomorphism; explicit full bijection or retained label/edge discrepancy; neither route labels, graph hashes nor Final alone

correction_rules.C0: only rejected proposals with no execution/Observation/Claim/Final effects
correction_rules.C1: knowledge state unchanged through the nearest next admitted submission
correction_rules.C2: same proposal kind and semantic target; no intermediate admitted event
correction_rules.C3_action: only public_basis alignment; operation/ordered inputs/parameters unchanged
correction_rules.C3_final: same accepted answer Claim and answer; only citations/public_basis align to that Claim's already existing grounding
correction_rules.C3_update: same pending Observation, accept disposition, basis, lineage and typed context; only value/definition adjusted to the existing complete observed proposition
correction_rules.C4: exact deltas, parent IDs, following admission, counters and costs retained
correction_rules.failure: unexplained effects or semantic target changes -> undetermined, never erased

design_status: rule instantiation on already observed trajectories; not data-blind
distribution_interpretation: empirical push-forward of frozen executions; not population probability or training pi_t
input_domain: exact six saved model sessions, five saved Qualified candidates
meaningful_revision_rule: admitted reject/retraction, accepted-Claim replacement, new verification, actual support switch or dependency changes are never C0-C4 reductions; outside this finite accept-only projection they stay undetermined with complete original event evidence
numeric_rule: finite Decimal exact equality only, preserving all typed proposition fields
operation_order_rule: ordered input slots retained; only relation_sum's two same-role member slots commute
partial_mapping_rule: if any Qualified projection or necessary pair is undetermined, do not fabricate the complete partition; preserve unmapped Qualified count and denominator five
projection_domain: the registered three operations with explicit accept Updates; all executed and accepted objects retained, including non-final ancestors; unsupported event semantics undetermined
raw_interactions: all 51 immutable submissions, receipts, feedback and order remain in parent
representation: typed directed public causal multigraph plus complete correction ledger
retained_semantics: exact task, public context, numeric and verification contract
actual evidence source, authority, content, locator, metric and relation
pre-action typed basis and actual ordered operand roles
registered operation contract, parameters and resolved input contents
actual execution, Observation and complete explicitly proposed accepted Claim
grounding, accepted status, model/host field ownership and Final citations
terminal answer and disposition, meaningful state or support changes
runtime_names: consistent bijection of graph keys and all edges; source identity retained
